title: What to do if a tsunami hits
WHAT IF A
TSUNAMI HITS?
scenes.say: You're on the beach. Suddenly, the ground starts shaking. You might have only minutes.
First, survive the quake. Drop, cover, and hold on.
If it shook for twenty seconds or more, that's your warning. Don't wait for a siren.
Then the sea pulls back, and you can see the ocean floor.
People walk out to look. Don't. The wave is coming back.
Run uphill or inland. Aim for thirty meters up, or about a mile from the shore.
Can't get that far? Go up the highest strong concrete building you can reach.
Then stay there. The first wave often isn't the biggest, and they can keep coming for hours.
So the next time the beach starts shaking... you'll know exactly what to do.
